description: A composite finite-element figure made of eight contour-map images plus two Abaqus-style colour-bar legends; its caption assigns (a) equivalent strain, (b) dislocation distribution (m⁻²), (c) grain size distribution (μm) and (d) flow stress (MPa). Every map shows two flat rhombus-shaped specimen views (front surface and mid-plane) with a small X–Y–Z axis triad, all drawn in the same blue→green→yellow→orange→red palette and carrying no printed data values. In reading order the maps warm progressively: the first is dominantly blue–cyan with mid-blue diagonal bands (the "X"-shaped deformation pattern); the second keeps cool outer fields but develops a yellow–orange elliptical core; the third shows a large dark-red central ellipse. Later maps are mainly yellow–orange with red corner patches, an orange–red left view with a green right view around a blue–cyan core, and green fields around a dark-blue central ellipse (a reversed pattern). The legends read "SDV6 (Avg: 75%)", 13 levels +9.910e+00 to +4.628e+01, and "SDV4 (Avg: 75%)", 13 levels +6.568e+02 to +5.480e+03. Because the legends carry no quantity or unit, the SDV-to-panel assignment is not verifiable from the pixels alone.
measured_quantities: SDV6 contour value (no unit given; legend +9.910e+00 to +4.628e+01)
SDV4 contour value (no unit given; legend +6.568e+02 to +5.480e+03)

observations.observation: The group contains eight numerical contour maps, each showing two flat rhombus-shaped specimen views plus a small X–Y–Z coordinate triad.
Two Abaqus-style legends are present: 'SDV6 (Avg: 75%)' spanning +9.910e+00 to +4.628e+01 and 'SDV4 (Avg: 75%)' spanning +6.568e+02 to +5.480e+03, each with 13 discrete contour levels.
Neither legend states a physical quantity or unit, so which SDV corresponds to strain, dislocation density, grain size or flow stress cannot be determined from the pixels.
No axis labels, spatial scale bar, specimen dimensions or numeric data labels are printed on any of the contour maps; only the colour bars carry numbers.

The observed colour patterns include both a family with a warm central ellipse (highest values at the specimen centre) and a family with a cool/blue central ellipse (lowest values at the centre), i.e. mutually reversed spatial distributions.
The caption states (a) equivalent strain map, (b) dislocation distribution map (m⁻²), (c) grain size distribution map (μm) and (d) flow stress map (MPa).
The citing text states the simulation covers MAF-1, MAF-3 and MAF-5, and contours are given for the specimens' midplanes and front surface (perpendicular to the constrained direction).
The citing text states the maximum strain in the central region after one MAF pass is approximately 0.6, exceeding the applied external strain value of 0.46.
The citing text states the maximum central strain after five MAF passes is approximately 2.6, surpassing the applied external strain value of 2.3.
The citing text states the grain size distribution shows a reverse pattern relative to dislocation density, with coarser grains in the outer region and finer grains in the central part.

The citing text states the simulation displays an 'X'-shaped deformation pattern and that the simulation does not accurately reproduce the experimental specimen distortion (attributed to the absence of crystallographic texture effects).
The citing text states stress levels rise markedly with MAF passes, consistent with increasing strain hardening and dislocation density.

subfigures.description: Contour map of two rhombus-shaped specimen views with an X–Y–Z triad; colours restricted to dark blue, mid blue, cyan and green, with darker blue diagonal bands over a cyan/green field. No warm colours, i.e. the lowest values of the set.
Contour map of two rhombus views; blue–cyan outer fields with a yellow–orange elliptical core in the right-hand view, ringed by green. A diagonal X-shaped banding is visible in the left view.

Contour map of two rhombus views; left view green with yellow and blue diagonal bands, right view dominated by a large dark-red central ellipse bordered by orange then yellow — the highest values shown in the group.
Abaqus-style colour bar headed 'SDV6 (Avg: 75%)' with 13 discrete levels, reading from +9.910e+00 at the bottom (dark blue/black) to +4.628e+01 at the top (red). No unit given.
Contour map of two rhombus views, both largely yellow–orange with red patches concentrated at the specimen corners; values are high and fairly uniform across the surface.
Contour map of two rhombus views; the left view is orange–red overall, the right view is green with an orange–yellow rim surrounding a blue–cyan central ellipse (centre lower than rim).

Contour map of two rhombus views; left view green with yellow patches and orange/red diagonal bands near one end, right view green with a large dark-blue central ellipse — the reverse pattern of map-3/map-6.
Abaqus-style colour bar headed 'SDV4 (Avg: 75%)' with 13 discrete levels, reading from +6.568e+02 at the bottom (dark blue/black) to +5.480e+03 at the top (red). No unit given.
Contour map of two rhombus views, almost entirely blue: dark-blue rims with mid-blue interiors, no green/yellow/red. The lowest and most uniform values in the group.
Contour map of two rhombus views; left view deep blue with a lighter diagonal band, right view with a blue rim around a green centre, i.e. centre values slightly higher than the rim.

unreadable_items: Panel letters (a)–(d) are not visible in the supplied crops, so individual maps cannot be bound with certainty to the caption's four labels
Colour-bar legends are headed only 'SDV4' and 'SDV6' with no quantity name or unit; the SDV→physical-quantity mapping cannot be read from the pixels
No spatial scale, specimen dimensions or coordinate-axis units are printed on the maps
Whether the two views in each map are the front surface and mid-plane (as the citing text states) cannot be confirmed from the pixels
Whether each map corresponds to MAF-1, MAF-3 or MAF-5 is not indicated in the visible image content
